name: base-manual-capture
summary: 域中立的操作手册截图采集基座 Skill：AI 按功能描述自主操作可访问系统，逐步截图并与用户交互确认，产出截图台账与操作路径记录，供 pg-manual-builder 等写作层成稿。
runtime_requirements: Requires one usable browser automation tool at runtime: Playwright MCP, browser-use MCP, or a local playwright CLI (any one is sufficient).
The capture ledger and trace are the source-of-truth contract; keep screenshots and ledger in sync before handing off to a manual-writing skill.
post_install_hints: This skill only captures screenshots and records the operation path; manual prose is written by pg-manual-builder (or another writing-layer skill).
Never write real credentials into the ledger or trace; follow references/REFERENCE-REDACTION-RULES.md.
Beware of common pitfalls: polling SPA timeouts, headless layout collapse, route guard redirects, Windows GBK printing crashes, toast capture timing.
